title: JavaScript syntax diagnostic and hover tooltip
naturalLanguageTask: In Lynxtron Fiddle, introduce a JavaScript syntax error in the top-left main.js editor, verify that a red wavy underline appears, hover that underline, verify that its diagnostic tooltip says 'Expression expected.', and finally restore the editor without saving.

setup.readyAssertion: Lynxtron Fiddle is the foreground window, no Welcome or other modal dialog covers it, and the unobstructed main.js editor visibly contains the default main-process source including app.whenReady and LynxWindow

precondition: The foreground window is Lynxtron Fiddle, no modal dialog is open, and the unobstructed main.js editor is editable and visibly contains the default main-process source including app.whenReady and LynxWindow

steps.target: the top-left main.js source editor, inside its editable code area

steps.prompt: The main.js editor now visibly contains exactly the probe text 'const actOnceSyntaxProbe = ;' instead of the default source
A red wavy underline is visibly marking the missing expression immediately before the semicolon in main.js containing 'const actOnceSyntaxProbe = ;'

steps.target: the red wavy underline immediately before the semicolon in the main.js line 'const actOnceSyntaxProbe = ;'

steps.prompt: {visible: boolean, message: string | null}, determine whether a diagnostic tooltip is visible over or near the hovered red syntax-error underline, and transcribe its diagnostic message when visible
